title: Irie 6.75″ Klein Incycler with UFO Perc Rig
description: The 6.75″ Klein Incycler with UFO Perc Rig from iRie features a sturdy base and an extended mouthpiece in several colourful accents. The vapour passing through a reinforced joint is diffused through a built-in UFO percolator for improved flavour and cooler dabs.
